# adapter

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/resolution/githubevent/adapter"
```

Package adapter implements the GitHubEvent resolution Adapter.

This file owns the Adapter — a thin struct wrapper around resolve.ResolveGitHubEvent. The Adapter exists to satisfy interface\-based injection points in the application layer where a concrete resolution dependency must be passed as a value rather than called as a free function.

Current deps are intentionally empty — client and logger will be added here when resolution requires cross\-CR reads or observability hooks. Until then, resolution is pure and stateless so no deps are needed.

<a name="Adapter"></a>
## type Adapter

Adapter wraps the GitHubEvent resolution function for interface\-based injection. Stateless — all resolution logic lives in resolve.ResolveGitHubEvent.

Planned future deps \(add when needed\):

- client client.Client — for cross\-CR reads during resolution.
- log logr.Logger — for resolution observability.
